يختزلون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَزِلُونَ (yaḵtazilūna) /jax.ta.zi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# يُخْتَزَلُونَ (yuḵtazalūna) /jux.ta.za.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
